grammar_tips.title: Using Quantities and Measures
grammar_tips.explanation: Use phrases like 'a cup of', 'a teaspoon of', 'a pinch of' to show amounts. Example: Add a pinch of salt.

explanation_translation.Hindi: 'a cup of', 'a teaspoon of', 'a pinch of' जैसे वाक्यांश मात्रा बताने के लिए उपयोग करें। उदाहरण: Add a pinch of salt.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 量を表すときは「a cup of」「a teaspoon of」「a pinch of」などを使います。例: Add a pinch of salt.

grammar_tips.title: Sequencing Steps
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'first', 'then', 'next', 'finally' to order steps. Example: First chop the onions, then fry them.

explanation_translation.Hindi: कदमों का क्रम बताने के लिए 'first', 'then', 'next', 'finally' का उपयोग करें। उदाहरण: First chop the onions, then fry them.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 手順の順番には「first」「then」「next」「finally」を使います。例: First chop the onions, then fry them.

grammar_tips.title: Imperatives for Instructions
grammar_tips.explanation: Use the base verb to give instructions: 'Cut', 'Mix', 'Bake'. Example: Bake at 180°C.

explanation_translation.Hindi: निर्देश देने के लिए मूल क्रिया का प्रयोग करें: 'Cut', 'Mix', 'Bake'। उदाहरण: Bake at 180°C.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 指示には動詞の原形を使います（Cut, Mix, Bake）。例: Bake at 180°C.

grammar_tips.title: Taste Adjustments with 'too' and 'not enough'
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'too + adjective' and 'not + adjective + enough' to describe taste. Example: The soup is too salty. It is not sweet enough.

explanation_translation.Hindi: स्वाद बताने के लिए 'too + adjective' और 'not + adjective + enough' का उपयोग करें। उदाहरण: The soup is too salty. It is not sweet enough.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 味の表現に「too + 形容詞」「not + 形容詞 + enough」を使います。例: The soup is too salty. It is not sweet enough.
